meta_title: North East Regional Plumbers | Plumber Newcastle
meta_description: North East Regional Plumbers offer expert plumbing across Newcastle and the wider North East. Fast response, free quotes, and reliable workmanship. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Newcastle Plumbers — Free Quotes Available
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, leaking boiler, or blocked drain — we get to you fast and fix it properly, first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Newcastle & the North East
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full bathroom installations, we handle every plumbing job with skill, speed, and transparency.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, and plumbing failures don't wait for office hours — and neither do we. We respond rapidly across Newcastle and surrounding areas to minimise damage and restore your water supply fast.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: A faulty boiler leaves you without heat or hot water, especially when you need it most. Our engineers diagnose and repair all major boiler brands, and carry out annual servicing to keep your system running efficiently.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Whether you're fitting a new suite or completely redesigning your bathroom, we manage every aspect of the plumbing to a high standard. We work cleanly, keep disruption to a minimum, and leave the job finished properly.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Persistent blockages can cause serious damage if left untreated. We clear blocked drains, toilets, and waste pipes quickly using professional equipment, restoring full flow and preventing repeat issues.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can silently damage your property for months before they're noticed. We locate the source accurately and carry out durable repairs, saving you from costly structural damage down the line.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: From power flushing and radiator replacements to full central heating installations, we keep your home warm and your heating bills under control. All work is carried out to current regulations and building standards.

about_pullquote: We built our reputation doing the job right, not just quickly.
about_para_1: North East Regional Plumbers was established to bring dependable, fairly priced plumbing to homeowners and businesses across Newcastle and the wider North East. With over a decade of hands-on experience, our team has tackled everything from routine repairs in Jesmond to full heating system overhauls in Gateshead.
about_para_2: What keeps our customers coming back is straightforward: we show up when we say we will, we explain exactly what needs doing and why, and we never cut corners. Our work is guaranteed, our pricing is transparent, and our goal is always to leave every property better than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. I had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning and they were with me within the hour. Sorted the problem quickly, tidied up after themselves, and the price was very fair. Would highly recommend to anyone in Newcastle.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used North East Regional Plumbers to install a new bathroom suite and I couldn't be happier. Professional from start to finish, kept me informed throughout, and the finished result looks fantastic. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had a persistent leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers couldn't fix properly. These lads found the root cause straight away and sorted it for good. Honest, knowledgeable, and great value. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Alison R.
